targets.rawSql: SELECT a.symbol AS ativo,a.name,CASE p.period_seconds WHEN 900 THEN 'M15' WHEN 3600 THEN 'H1' ELSE 'D1' END AS periodo,CASE WHEN s.candle_epoch=(extract(epoch from now())::bigint/p.period_seconds)*p.period_seconds-p.period_seconds AND s.reason='setup_confirmado' THEN s.side ELSE 'SEM SINAL' END AS sinal,CASE WHEN s.candle_epoch IS NULL THEN 'sem_dados' WHEN s.candle_epoch<(extract(epoch from now())::bigint/p.period_seconds)*p.period_seconds-p.period_seconds THEN 'dados_atrasados' ELSE s.reason END AS motivo,upper(coalesce(r.state,'sem_registro')) AS estado,to_timestamp(s.candle_epoch+p.period_seconds) AS vela_fechada FROM indicator_symbols a CROSS JOIN (VALUES (900),(3600),(86400)) p(period_seconds) LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT * FROM pullback_signals x WHERE x.symbol=a.symbol AND x.period_seconds=p.period_seconds AND x.setup_version LIKE 'pullback-1-%' ORDER BY x.candle_epoch DESC LIMIT 1) s ON true LEFT JOIN pullback_registry r ON r.symbol=a.symbol AND r.period_seconds=p.period_seconds AND r.setup_version=s.setup_version WHERE a.active ORDER BY a.symbol,p.period_seconds

SELECT r.symbol AS ativo,CASE r.period_seconds WHEN 900 THEN 'M15' WHEN 3600 THEN 'H1' ELSE 'D1' END AS periodo,r.setup_version AS versao,upper(r.state) AS estado,coalesce(e.purchased,0) AS compras_demo,coalesce(e.settled,0) AS liquidadas_demo,round(e.lower_95::numeric,4) AS limite_95,coalesce(e.wins,0) AS wins_demo,CASE WHEN e.settled >= 200 THEN round(((e.wins+0.5)/(e.settled+1.0))::numeric,4) END AS prob_empirica FROM pullback_registry r JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=r.symbol AND a.active LEFT JOIN pullback_broker_status e ON e.symbol=r.symbol AND e.period_seconds=r.period_seconds AND e.setup_version=r.setup_version WHERE r.setup_version LIKE 'pullback-1-%' ORDER BY r.symbol,r.period_seconds
